## Description

Nonparametric bootstrap helpers in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]:
percentile, bias-corrected, and bias-corrected and accelerated
confidence intervals from a matrix of draws,
and nonparametric bootstrap and jackknife half-vectorized
covariance matrices computed in C++.
The functions are internal; other projects copy them.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `nBootstrap` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/nBootstrap) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/nBootstrap")
```

## More Information

See
[GitHub Pages](https://ijapesigan.github.io/nBootstrap)
for package documentation.
